text:
𝗣𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗗𝗔𝗥 𝟭𝟯𝟱* 𝗢𝗙𝗙 𝟰𝟴! 🔥

Rajat Patidar walked in at 57/3 and hit 135* off 48 balls for Madhya Pradesh in SMAT.
MP made 250/6, their highest T20 total, and beat Assam by 131 runs.

Best T20 knock you've seen? 👇
#SMAT #Cricket

👉 Rajat Patidar ne 48 balls mein naabaad 135 runs thoke
👉 Madhya Pradesh 57/3 pe the, jab Patidar crease par aaye
👉 MP ne 250/6 banaya, apna ab tak ka sabse bada T20 total
👉 Assam ko 131 runs se haraya

Aapne aisi hitting kab dekhi thi? Comment karo 👇
